title: Planning as tree search, and pruning
summary: A task with deterministic transitions and large losses; models of look-ahead, discounting and pruning below large losses; in-sample comparison by integrated BIC, and what it does and does not show about planning.

preparation.description: Read the abstract of Huys et al. (2012).

Read the model comparison by integrated BIC.
